text: Delivered the checkout flow with clear component tests and explained schema decisions in writing.
Job-posting wizard worked as specified; two validation edge cases were fixed after review.
Itinerary API contract was clear. Response times varied during the second month.
Filtering component handled combined filters smoothly and shipped with unit tests.
Dashboard state handling with NgRx was easy to extend; keyboard navigation issues were fixed quickly.
Good developer but communication style was not my favourite.
Order list query dropped from about 1.8 s to 0.4 s after the index change, documented in a short note.
Ledger rules were well tested; the 0.4 percent reconciliation mismatch was still open at handover.
Admin API with JWT roles was delivered on schedule with integration tests.
Baseline beat the popularity baseline offline; cold-start results were weaker than hoped.
Citations traced to the right passages in 58 of 60 evaluation questions and the evaluation set was documented.
Chunking fix for tables made a visible difference; wished for an automated regression check.
Pipeline built and deployed to staging on the first day of the sprint; image scan reports were not shared.
Deployment runbook was clear and a rollback was rehearsed once.
Staging migration was solid, but the production cut-over was deferred and we needed a follow-up contract.
Android build installed cleanly and notifications arrived within seconds in testing.
Offline conflicts still lose edits in rare cases; the conflict banner is helpful but not a fix.
Not what I imagined. Felt slow.
